items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now, what about, uh... Lead belly? Did he ever do any of that type of work with his gang, you know? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, yes, sir. He did.

ctx.x: No, sir. We don't sing with the shovel. We don't have time to sing with the shovel. We need all that wind and shovel with it.
Now, what about, uh... Lead belly? Did he ever do any of that type of work with his gang, you know?

Well, yes, sir. He did. Before, uh... He... He... He got on the yard. Well, he went to the doctor several times. The doctor found out he wasn't able to work. They just put him on the yard and told him to take the other yard.
